title: Request-path Ribbonboard: p50/p95/p99 by model & route with streaming split
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a lightweight, interactive dashboard (Ribbonboard) that surfaces p50/p95/p99 latency for every model+route combination with a breakdown for streaming vs non-streaming IO modes. This view should make it easy for SRE/Platform/Runtime teams to spot regressions, compare model variants, and pivot from aggregated SLOs to individual route trouble spots.
acceptance_criteria: Ribbonboard lists all active model+route pairs and exposes p50/p95/p99 for the last 1h/6h/24h windows
Each model+route row can toggle to show streaming and non-streaming splits side-by-side
Clicking a row opens quick links: trace samples (trace-id sampler), related dashboards, and the model rollout/variant metadata
Dashboard loads for tenants with up to 5k distinct model+route pairs in under 4s (backend query latency < 2s)
Metrics are derived from existing latency metrics and tracing hooks; no new agent deployment required
SLO alert rule mapping included for top 200 routes (p95 > threshold)
implementation_notes: Metric sources: use metrics pipeline agg: latency_ms.{p50,p95,p99}.route.model.{streaming,nonstreaming} from Prometheus -> ClickHouse rollup
Tracing hooks: add unified trace link generation using trace_id sampler (ENG-120700) to correlate Ribbonboard rows to traces
Backend: new Ribbonboard API endpoint that returns paginated rows with minimal payload (ids + percentiles + flags), supports time-window param
Frontend: console panel with inline comparison bars, sparkline for last 24h, and lightweight drilldown modal
Caching: client-side 60s TTL; server-side materialized view refreshed every 30s for high-cardinality groups
Security: follow existing Console ACLs (route-level visibility) — no additional privilege changes
Performance tests: synthetic workload using staging replay of production 24h tail to validate sub-4s load target
